name: sit-sizing
description: SIT Sizing Model: estimate SIT and QE effort with a versioned, auditable engine.

scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm test
scripts.dev:up: node scripts/ensure-dev-env.mjs && docker compose --env-file .env -f docker/compose.yaml -f docker/compose.dev.yaml up -d --build --wait db mail keycloak web && docker compose --env-file .env -f docker/compose.yaml -f docker/compose.dev.yaml run --rm seed
scripts.dev:down: node scripts/ensure-dev-env.mjs && docker compose --env-file .env -f docker/compose.yaml -f docker/compose.dev.yaml down
scripts.dev:logs: node scripts/ensure-dev-env.mjs && docker compose --env-file .env -f docker/compose.yaml -f docker/compose.dev.yaml logs -f web
scripts.dev:obs: node scripts/ensure-dev-env.mjs && docker compose --env-file .env -f docker/compose.yaml -f docker/compose.dev.yaml -f docker/compose.obs.yaml up -d --build --wait db mail keycloak web jaeger
scripts.dev:reset: node scripts/ensure-dev-env.mjs && docker compose --env-file .env -f docker/compose.yaml -f docker/compose.dev.yaml --profile obs down -v
scripts.stack:up: node scripts/ensure-dev-env.mjs && docker compose --env-file .env -f docker/compose.yaml up -d --build --wait db mail keycloak web && docker compose --env-file .env -f docker/compose.yaml run --rm seed
scripts.stack:down: node scripts/ensure-dev-env.mjs && docker compose --env-file .env -f docker/compose.yaml down
